items.item_text: Current BLS from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
Bachelors of Science in Nursing (BSN) or Masters of Science in Nursing (MSN)
1 year of clinical experience in an acute psychiatric setting
Experience caring for patients and families experiencing mental/ behavior health issues.
Minimum 2 years' experience in a psychiatric setting with children

At UCLA Health, our ABC Childhood Partial Hospital Program provides specialized psychiatric care and evidence-based treatment for children living with mental health issues. As part of a collaborative multidisciplinary team, you will play a vital role in delivering high-quality patient care while supporting positive clinical outcomes and exceptional patient experiences. Key responsibilities:
Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate individualized patient care
Perform comprehensive patient assessments and document clinical findings
Administer treatments, medications, and interventions in accordance with physician orders and nursing standards
Collaborate with physicians and interdisciplinary team members to coordinate care and support treatment goals
Educate patients and families regarding treatment plans, health conditions, and ongoing care needs
Advocate for patient safety, quality outcomes, and an exceptional patient experience
Participate in quality improvement, evidence-based practice, and professional development activities
